title: FIELD INDEX 0.6.2 / TRACE VERIFY
objective: Move policy-resolution trace work out of schema-only space and into the actual FIELD INDEX interface as a focus-bound local instrument.
behavior: TRACE / VERIFY is collapsed by default inside FIELD INDEX.
Current shared FI focus is bound as an opaque resource ref for the local reference trace.
Typed event text is processed locally only to derive event_ref; raw text is not embedded in committed/exported trace.
Seven gates render: READ, REMEMBER, ACKNOWLEDGE, ANSWER, DRAFT, ACT, ESCALATE.
Causal trace renders selector -> matched policy -> per-gate operations/denies -> stage -> seven gate finals -> resolution final.
STRUCTURAL / REPLAY / SEALED statuses run through /policy-trace-verifier.mjs.
COMMIT TRACE stores trace-only JSON in browser localStorage; EXPORT emits trace JSON.
No fetch/network action exists in field-policy-trace.mjs.
Aperture TRACE opens the same instrument for the currently focused route.
Changing FIELD focus marks the displayed trace stale and disables COMMIT until rerun.
First-open TRACE runs a context-aware reference demo: COMMS for communication surfaces, HOUSE for house surfaces, CHANGE elsewhere.
Explicit COMMS / HOUSE / CHANGE demo buttons remain available for comparison.
AXIAL TRACE carries selected FIELD route or exact HOUSE anchor into FIELD as a session-local resource address.
The AXIAL handoff contributes address/provenance only; it never grants READ/REMEMBER/ANSWER/DRAFT/ACT/ESCALATE authority.

verification.reason: Repository/source verification completed in connected GitHub environment; live Pages deployment/browser execution not yet independently observed.

laws_preserved: RAW INPUT DOES NOT ENTER TRACE BY DEFAULT
next_state: Ordinary use: focus any FIELD route, invoke TRACE from Aperture or top nav, inspect seven gates/event stream/verifier state. If focus changes, rerun before committing. Bind real private policy material only when available.
